description: C4, a transport shot down with a keyed passenger, on Show Down. k: an ATLAS loads TXCOM1 (TransportedExplodeAs=TX_BLAST_E) at (800, 700); once it is aboard (the commander's +0x86 names the ATLAS), `tacli order --unit N --expect ARMATLAS move pos 800 1600` flies it toward k_gun, the AI's tower at (800, 1600), which downs it on the way (TX_AA: 1000 to the ATLAS, 1 to a commander); the ATLAS's cargo loop kills the commander with kind 6, a carried death: TX_BLAST_E, 111. c: the same at x 4300 with VTCOM0, no key: stock's COMMANDER_BLAST. Each ring is two unarmed CORKROGs (29 918 HP) 260 either side of the load site: read their HP (+0x108) before and after. TX_BLAST_E takes 111 and TX_BLAST_S 222 from anywhere within 2000; stock's COMMANDER_BLAST takes thousands within 950. The cases are 3500 apart. Content: tools/datakeys_fixture.py into the instance's gamedir.
